lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: Hello, Commander!

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: I'm Teddy, and also an aspiring Commander myself.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: I'm honored to have the opportunity to speak with you.
There's no need to speak so formally.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: Yes, I do!

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: Nearly all the cadets at the military academy voted you as their role models.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: Including me, of course. Hehe.
Thanks.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: It's just that...

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: I'm about to graduate soon!

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: But I'm unsure whether I can actually do what's expected of me while up on the surface.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: What can I do to be more like you?
I'm not that special, you know.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: And you're humble as well! Unbelievable!

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: Meanwhile, everyone makes fun of me for being so gutless.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: I know the Nikkes do all the actual fighting, but you never know what you'll encounter on the surface!

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: If it's not too inconvenient, I'd like to ask you for some advice.
Tbh, I have none to give.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: Oh, all right! No worries, I know how busy you must be.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text:
I know this is a big ask,
but is it be possible for me to tag along and see some real action?
Not just anyone can use the elevator.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: Aw, come on! I'm sure you know ways around that.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: You have a mission today, right?
Don't even think about it.

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: A stickler for the rules, huh? That's cool!

lines.speaker: teddy
lines.text: Anyway, see you later!
